name: Bulgaria

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 6437360 inhabitants, recorded as 6.437 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Still an opening estimate. Attempted on 2026-07-27 in the transversal venues pass and abandoned on access, not on absence — the note exists so the next attempt starts where this one stopped. Bulgaria is the one country in this batch with a register of exactly the right shape: the Ministry of Culture publishes its list of state drama and drama-puppet theatres, and a separate register of cultural institutes. Three routes into mc.government.bg were tried and all three answered 503, including the print view; a fourth attempt through curl failed on certificate verification rather than reaching the server. The one page that did answer, the Bulgarian theatre directory at theatre.art.bg, returned a partial and garbled reading — four drama-puppet theatres, one of them under a name that does not exist — and was not usable. What surfaced without being read: the country's puppet theatres are the state houses at Sofia, Plovdiv, Varna, Burgas, Ruse, Stara Zagora, Sliven, Yambol, Vidin, Targovishte and Dobrich, with drama-puppet theatres at Silistra, Haskovo and Shumen, and a national puppetry week said to unite state, municipal and private houses across nineteen towns. Every item in that sentence comes from search summaries and none of it is a source. No value produced.

Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. One establishment retained: NATFIZ Krastyo Sarafov, Sofia. Criteria read at source: higher education, degree-granting with a bachelor's award and the named professional qualification Puppet Theatre Actor, puppetry explicit in the title, national academy under the state. The same institution also carries a puppet directing stream; counted by establishment, so 1 and not 2. Upper bound held at 1: the page read states the qualification can be obtained only at NATFIZ, an exhaustiveness claim that was read rather than inferred. Caveat: that claim covers only the performing stream.

establishments.name: НАТФИЗ «Кръстьо Сарафов» — National Academy for Theatre and Film Arts
establishments.award: Bachelor's degree, professional qualification Puppet Theatre Actor
establishments.description: Bulgaria's national theatre and film academy, founded 1948. It carries both acting and directing streams for puppet theatre, and its own pages state the actor qualification is obtainable nowhere else in the country.

venues: Bulgaria stopped on access on 2026-07-27. The register to reach is the Ministry of Culture's list of state drama and drama-puppet theatres at mc.government.bg, which answered 503 on three routes; the ministry's register of cultural institutes is the second. Both would give public status and town in one document, which is what Poland lacked. The candidate towns are known and the work is one register away.
